He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball|Kent State Golden Flashes]]. ==High school career== Pippen attended Allen Academy in [[Detroit|Detroit, Michigan]] and played alongside [[Rocket Watts]].{{cite news |last1=Goricki |first1=David |title=MAC notes: Detroit's Danny Pippen shines bright for Golden Flashes |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/2020/01/27/mac-notes-detroits-danny-pippen-shines-bright-golden-flashes/4588110002/ |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[The Detroit News]] |date=January 27, 2020}} As a junior, he averaged 16 points and eight rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Markowski |first1=Tom |title=Boys Basketball Preseason Top 25 Players: U-D's Winston has firm grip on his future; top contender for Mr. Basketball award |url=https://www.statechampsnetwork.com/rankings/boys-basketball-preseason-top-25-players-u-d-s-winston-has-firm-grip-on-his-future-top-contender-for-mr-basketball-award/ |website=State Champs Network |access-date=November 11, 2021 |date=December 8, 2015}} Pippen averaged 12.8 points and 12.5 rebounds per game as a senior, earning First Team Class C honors. He finished as Allen's career leader in blocks with 174. Pippen committed to playing college basketball for [[Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball|Kent State]].{{cite news |title=Boys Basketball All-State Teams |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/88768922/detroit-free-press/ |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |date=April 10, 2016 |page=C7|via=Newspapers.com}} ==College career== Pippen came off the bench as a freshman and averaged 3 points and 2.7 rebounds per game. As a sophomore, he averaged 8.1 points, 6.8 rebounds and 1.6 blocks per game. Pippen sat out the 2018–19 season as a redshirt after undergoing microfracture surgery on his right knee. During his junior season, he played through pain due to a torn meniscus on his other knee, and only missed one game against [[Buffalo Bulls men's basketball|Buffalo]] due to a back problem. Pippen averaged 14.3 points, 7.1 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game, earning Honorable Mention All-[[Mid-American Conference|MAC]] accolades. He underwent microfracture surgery on his left knee in March 2020.{{cite news |last1=Moff |first1=Allen |title=Pippen healthy, more determined than ever as Kent State's senior leader |url=https://www.record-courier.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2020/12/24/pippen-healthy-more-determined-than-ever-kent-states-senior-leader/4008486001/ |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[Record-Courier (Ohio)|The Record-Courier]] |date=December 24, 2020}} On January 5, 2021, Pippen scored a career-high 34 points to go with 16 rebounds and four blocks in an 84–82 loss to [[Toledo Rockets men's basketball|Toledo]].{{cite news |title=Littleson carries Toledo over Kent State 84–82 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401253007 |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 5, 2021}} He tied his career-high of 34 points on January 27, to go with 11 rebounds and surpassed 1,000 points in a 96–91 win against [[Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball|Bowling Green]].{{cite news |title=Pippen scores 34 to carry Kent St. over Bowling Green 96–91 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401281545 |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 27, 2021}} As a senior, Pippen averaged 19.3 points, 8.7 rebounds and 1.3 blocks per game, and led the MAC in double-doubles with nine. He was named to the First Team All-MAC.{{cite news |title=Kent State senior forward Pippen named First Team All-MAC |url=https://www.record-courier.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/03/10/kent-state-senior-danny-pippen-has-been-named-first-team-all-mac/6940746002/ |access-date=November 11, 2021 |work=[[Record-Courier (Ohio)|The Record-Courier]] |date=March 10, 2021}} ==Professional career== In October 2021, Pippen joined the [[Greensboro Swarm]] of the [[NBA G League]] after a successful tryout.{{cite web|first=Justin|last=Trujillo|title=Swarm Announce Training Camp Roster And Coaching Staff For 2021-22|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/swarmannouncetrainingcamproster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 24, 2021|access-date=November 11, 2021}} He appeared in one game for the Swarm{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/gleague/players/p/pippeda01d.html|title=Danny Pippen|work=basketball-reference.com|access-date=January 9, 2023}} before being waived on December 17, 2021.{{cite web|title=2021-2022 Greensboro Swarm Transactions History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Greensboro-Swarm/45/Transaction_History/2022|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 20, 2021}} He was acquired by the [[Maine Celtics]] on December 19, played in two games for the team, and was then waived again on December 21.{{cite web|title=2021-2022 Maine Celtics Transactions History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Maine-Celtics/64/Transaction_History/2022|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 20, 2021}} On January 29, 2022, Pippen signed with [[G.S. Lavrio B.C.|Lavrio]] of the [[Greek Basket League]].{{cite web |title=Lavrio BC announces Rashad Vaughn, Danny Pippen |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/lavrio-bc-announces-rashad-vaughn-danny-pippen/ |website=sportando.basketball |access-date=January 9, 2023 |date=January 29, 2022 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} He appeared in three games for Lavrio between January 30 and March 6.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Danny-Pippen/404164|title=Danny Pippen|work=eurobasket.com|access-date=January 9, 2023|url-access=subscription}} On August 25, 2022, Pippen signed with [[Kobrat]] of the Finnish [[Korisliiga]].{{cite web |title=Danny Pippen ja
